Alaska's FY2024 therefore blends ~8.5 months of standalone Alaska with ~3.5 months of the combined company, which depresses its margins relative to a standalone or full-year-combined basis. A separate note: Southwest's net income exceeds its operating income, so its net margin ranks above its operating margin [DOC-1].

|---|---|---|---|

| 5 | American | $846M / $54,211M [DOC-1] | 1.6% |

**Conclusion:** Yes — Delta ranks first on both measures, at a 9.7% operating margin and a 5.6% net margin, ahead of United in each case [DOC-1]. The rankings diverge only at the bottom, where Southwest and American swap places between the two measures.

Yes — Delta is top-ranked in both (note: Alaska's FY2024 includes Hawaiian only from Sept 18, 2024, so it is not fully comparable).
